description.value:
Sometimes all you need is a warning shot to scare off your attacker, but if that doesn't work, you'll need something more convincing. The M2067 Defender from Constitutional Arms will almost certainly do the trick. This light machine gun was designed for all the righteous, upstanding citizens living in dangerous neighborhoods. With a remarkably high firing rate, large magazine and automatic reload, in the right conditions someone holding one of these could take out a whole army.

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Machine Gun • Skill: N/A • Range: N/A

Damage: N/A • Capacity: 80 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Bipod • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only fire in Autofire and Suppressive Fire. Reloading this weapon requires two Reload Actions. Requires BODY 8+ to wield unless Mounted, and BODY 10+ or paired Cyberarms to not reduce the user’s MOVE by 2 while wielded. A Nomad may choose to receive this weapon when they first install a Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mount.

Range: N/A
Pre-installed: Bipod (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Autofire and Suppressive Fire only; 2d6 is the standard Autofire damage.
  • Autofire only, so its DV table is the Autofire table.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
